captions.detailed: A realistic, highly detailed pair of binoculars in a matte black finish. It features two parallel optical barrels with blue-tinted glass lenses at both the objective and eyepiece ends, a central hinge bridge for interpupillary adjustment, and textured ribbed grip panels on the outer sides. The central hinge allows the two barrels to rotate slightly relative to each other, articulating naturally to adjust the distance between the eyes.
captions.instruction: Generate a realistic, highly detailed pair of binoculars with parallel optical barrels, blue glass lenses, a central hinge bridge, and ribbed side grips. The assembly must include a revolute joint on the central hinge to allow natural interpupillary adjustment.
captions.factory: The code constructs the binoculars using an ArticulatedObject. It builds two separate optical barrels (left and right) as parts using cylinders for the main body, tapered cones/cylinders for the objective and eyepiece ends, and circular faces for the blue-tinted lenses. Ribbed grip surfaces are added to the sides using a series of small, patterned box primitives. A central hinge pin and bridge are modeled as connecting cylinders, and a revolute joint is defined along the central axis to link the left and right assemblies, allowing them to rotate relative to each other.
